sections.name: test_full_workflow (part 1)
sections.title: Running the three-step survey workflow
sections.what: Runs a full survey build as a test. It asks the planner for a survey plan for a B2B customer satisfaction study, passes that plan to the author to write the questions, then passes the survey to the validator to score it. It checks that each step returns a success result or the expected fields, and prints the number of sections and questions along the way.
sections.why: Likely reason: the test checks that the three agents work together end to end, since each one's output is the next one's input. Reason for the specific study details is not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The test uses a real database session and asserts only on the shape of results, not on quality, so a survey can pass while being weak; if an assert fails, the database session is never closed.

sections.name: test_full_workflow (part 2)
sections.title: Printing results and closing the database
sections.what: Prints the validator's readiness score, issue count and pass or fail result, then shows the title and first two questions of the first two survey sections so a person can read them. Finally it closes the database session. Nothing here changes the survey itself.
sections.why: Likely reason: the printed output lets a person check the survey by eye when the test runs, because the assertions alone do not show what was produced. Closing the session releases the database connection at the end of a normal run.
sections.watch_out: The database is only closed when the test reaches this point, so any earlier failure leaves the session open, and the printed sample assumes every section has at least one question.

sections.name: entry point
sections.title: Running the test directly from the command line
sections.what: Lets a person run this workflow test by starting the file itself rather than through the test runner. Starting the file runs the same full workflow once and prints the output.
sections.why: Likely reason: it allows a quick manual run of the workflow without the full test tool, for debugging.
sections.watch_out: Running the file directly skips the test runner's setup, so a result can differ from a normal test run if that setup matters.
